riftseekers.description: Riftseekers dominate the Sanctum and control all planar manipulation.

muramite-legion.description: Muramite forces maintain a foothold in the Outer Ring but cannot breach the core.

discord-manifestations.description: Discord anomalies erupt unpredictably, especially near elemental chambers and the Rift Heart.

dragorn-resistance.description: Dragorn saboteurs operate covertly within the Ritual Chambers and Outer Ring.
